name: Vyre
description: Vyre is the agentic command center for AI-native teams. Our mission is to help every professional services team become AI-native. People and agents share chats, records, tasks, files and automations (Flows) on a server the team owns, and anything that leaves the team waits for a person's yes. Open source (Apache 2.0), self-hosted, any model: Claude, Codex, Grok and OpenRouter through your own subscriptions or keys. Reach it from the Vyre app on a Mac, on Windows, on a phone, or in a browser.

install.note: The Vyre app shows the user the install line and pairs the server with a code and four words. An agent runs the install line only if the user hands it that one line, for a server the agent created for them.

entry_point.note: Start here: what Vyre is, a map of the site and docs, how to map a business onto Vyre, and how to help set it up today.
